content.title: How MrBeast Built His YouTube Empire
content.text: Key Takeaways MrBeast is a popular YouTuber with over 470 million subscribers.He generates income through ad revenue and sponsorships.MrBeast often features charitable donations in his videos.He has a significant following on social media, with 634 million followers. Get personalized, AI-powered answers built on 27+ years of trusted expertise. Who Is MrBeast and How Has He Built His Wealth? Jimmy Donaldson, known as MrBeast, is a billionaire thanks largely to his wildly popular YouTube videos. His other business ventures include a food company, an online clothing store, and Beast Games, a game show on Amazon Prime Video. Learn how MrBeast made his money from wildly popular YouTube videos and more about his other business ventures. MrBeast’s Rise to Social Media Fame Donaldson has 634 million followers on social media and more than 470 million subscribers on his main YouTube channel, where his videos have almost 114 billion views. He is known for his stunts, such as staying in a cave for a week and living in a bunker for 100 days to win $500,000.1 He has a net worth of $2.6 billion and makes $50 million monthly from YouTube videos and other businesses.2 MrBeast’s Beginnings on YouTube Donaldson started making YouTube videos in 2013 when he was just 12 years old.2 His original videos primarily showed live play and strategies for video games such as Minecraft and Project Zomboid. In the next few years, he began creating videos about top YouTubers at the time, including how much they made from their channels and how to get views and subscribers on YouTube videos.3 By 2017, Donaldson regularly uploaded the challenges and stunt videos for which he eventually became famous.3 His first big YouTube breakout video showed him spending 44 hours counting to 100,000 in 2017. It was viewed 21 million times. He read the dictionary in other videos and took Ubers across the country.2 In 2018, Donaldson started doing stunt philanthropy with his YouTube videos. In one video, he had people place their hands on a stack of $1 million. The last one to let go got the cash. He also made a YouTube video where he gave $1,000 to strangers. In another YouTube video, he adopted every dog in an animal shelter.2 MrBeast’s Business Ventures Outside YouTube Beyond earning money from ad revenue and sponsorships for his YouTube channels, Donaldson sells clothes and other merchandise through his online shopping site. This is his second-biggest source of income.2 In 2020, Donaldson launched MrBeast Burger with Virtual Dining Concepts. According to Donaldson, MrBeast Burger made revenue of $100 million from December 2020 to July 2022.4 In 2022, he launched a food company, Feastables, that sells chocolate bars and gummy candy.2 His game show, Beast Games, which was inspired by the Netflix hit "Squid Game" about a dystopian game show, premiered on Dec. 19, 2024, on Amazon Prime Video. In it, 1,000 contestants were competing for a $5 million prize. Beast Games had 50 million views in just 25 days. Despite the show's success with viewers, Donaldson says he lost millions doing the game show.56 Donaldson has donated millions to charitable organizations, including Saint Jude Children's Research Hospital. He also donates money to homeless shelters and animal shelters.2 Related Articles and Insights Controversies Surrounding MrBeast’s Business Endeavors In 2023, Donaldson filed a lawsuit against Virtual Dining Concepts for harm to his brand due to the low quality of the food offered by MrBeast Burgers and other quality control issues. According to the lawsuit, Virtual Dining Concepts focused on expansion by pitching the same concept to other celebrities rather than managing the quality of MrBeast Burgers. As a result, the brand experienced quality control issues such as late orders, unmarked packaging, orders that didn't contain the proper items, website troubles, and failure to give customers refunds. Donaldson is seeking the right to terminate the MrBeast Burger business. Also in 2023, Virtual Dining Concepts filed a countersuit against Donaldson for $100 million, claiming Donaldson failed to honor his contract and interfered in the business between Virtual Dining Concepts and MrBeast Burger. The lawsuit also claimed that Donaldson used his social media fame to encourage followers to seek other products and to disparage the MrBeast Burger.7 The litigation continues as of March 2026.8 There is also controversy surrounding Beast Games. Competitors complained of unsafe working conditions on set, including a lack of food, being denied access to personal medications and hygiene products, and injuries caused by the game's physical challenges.9 A lawsuit filed in September 2024 accused Donaldson of creating unsafe working conditions for competitors who were aiming for the $5 million prize. The lawsuit includes allegations of sexual harassment and misrepresenting the odds of winning to competitors.10 Another season of the show is planned despite the ongoing lawsuit.11 The Bottom Line MrBeast, aka Jimmy Donaldson, built a $2.6 billion empire through popular YouTube videos, earning from ad revenue and sponsorships. He also ventures into fast food, clothing, and snacks. While his Amazon Prime game show, Beast Games, had high viewership, it incurred financial losses.
